```plato

    // The number of edge pairs that interfere. Zero for a simple ring; offered
    // alongside `IsSimpleRing` because "how badly" is the useful question when a repair
    // is being considered.
    RingSelfIntersectionCount(points: Array<Point2D>): Integer
        => points.Count.Range.Reduce(0, (total, i)
            => total + points.Count.Range.Reduce(0, (row, j)
                => row + (j > i ? (points.RingEdgesInterfere(i, j) ? 1 : 0) : 0)));
```
